# Metal Coatings


## Comprehensive metal coating capabilities for stronger and sustainable infrastructure


View Locations


For nearly six decades, AZZ has been protecting critical infrastructure from the destruction of metallic corrosion as North America’s leading provider of[galvanizing](https://www.azz.com/galvanizing/) for fabricated steel. In addition to hot-dip galvanizing, AZZ offers a[wide range of high-quality metal finishing and coating services](https://www.azz.com/surface-technologies/) . Our comprehensive metal coating capabilities create enduring infrastructure for constructing a stronger, safer, and[sustainable](https://www.azz.com/sustainability/) world.
